item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0041-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0041-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0041-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0041-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0041-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0041-E006","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"ARTICLE 19 recorded 272 attacks against journalists and media in Mexico during January–June 2023, including 68 intimidation or harassment cases, 61 cases of illegitimate use of public power, and 49 threats. It attributed 140 attacks to authorities, with state officials responsible for 23.5%, federal officials for 19.4%, and municipal officials for 8.4%. It also mentioned at least three journalist killings possibly linked to freedom of expression and documented a disappearance.","notes":["The excerpt lists the killings and disappearance with July dates, so their inclusion within the January–June attack total is not established."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0041-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0041-E008","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"In a March 21, 2023 article, López Obrador said that after Norma Piña became president of the Supreme Court, his administration was noticing more acts it considered illegal and unjust; he instructed that matters of public interest be taken to the FGR, Federal Judiciary Council, and Supreme Court while stating that the executive respected judicial decisions.","notes":["The excerpt dates the article update to March 21, 2023 but does not establish that the statement occurred in January."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0041-E009","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Banco de México’s table lists January 2023 values of 44.21, 43.65, and 5.19 and identifies underlying data from ENOE/INEGI, consumer-confidence data, and Banco de México/INEGI information.","notes":["The supplied excerpt does not preserve column headers, so it does not independently establish which value corresponds to real wage mass, consumer confidence, or remittances."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0041-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
